title: Does Parliament notice disasters, and whose?
excerpt: I counted, month by month, how often the House of Commons named the places of 64 UK disasters between 1910 and 2020. Attention jumps to 10 times its usual level in the month of a disaster and mostly fades within the year. Bigger death tolls bring more attention, but less than in proportion.
seo_description: How often did the House of Commons name the places of 64 UK disasters, 1910 to 2020, and for how long? A data study.
